The [[Carida Corsairs]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group maintained a '''home base''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] from which they launched raids along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. However, sometime before the [[Galactic War]], the base's existence was discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and wiped out by a Republic strike force. As a result, the Corsairs were soon torn apart, and the group's survivors became a laughing stock to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>
